'''Albert Alavedra Jiménez''' (born 26 February 1999) is a former Andorran [[Association football|footballer]] who played as a [[Defender (association football)#Centre-back|centre-back]].<ref>{{WorldFootball.net}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |url=http://labrujulacalahorra.com/albert-alavedra-nuevo-fichaje-para-el-cd-calahorra-b/ |title=Albert Alavedra, nuevo fichaje para el CD Calahorra B |trans-title=Albert Alavedra, new signing for CD Calahorra B |work=La Brújula de Calahorra |date=1 October 2020 |access-date=13 October 2020 |language=es}}</ref>

==Early life==
Alavedra was born in [[Castellbell i el Vilar]], near [[Manresa]] to an Andorran mother.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/esports/2016/03/24/mitja_vida_blanc_blau_97888_1128.html|website=Diari d'Andorra|title=Mitja vida de blanc-i-blau|language=ca|date=24 March 2016|accessdate=7 November 2020}}</ref>

==International career==
Alavedra made his international debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] on 13 October 2020 in the [[2020–21 UEFA Nations League D|UEFA Nations League]] against the [[Faroe Islands national football team|Faroe Islands]].<ref name="EUF">{{cite web |url=https://eu-football.info/_player.php?id=31170 |title=Albert Alavedra |website=EU-Football.info |access-date=13 October 2020}}</ref>
